'''2007 Oklahoma State Championship JW Millet LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[JW Millet]] at [[2007 Oklahoma State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' JW Millet III
* '''Deck name:''' Phatal Shield Buster
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
